purpose: Separate the effect of the convexity and growth constraints from that of network capacity in the SC-RVE in-domain accuracy gap between the constrained energies and the Unconstrained energy.
timing: Frozen on 2026-09-25 before any new cell is trained. The test/probe metrics of the two existing cells are already known; those of the new cells remain closed until their gate.

icnn_large.matching: same hidden widths as the Unconstrained energy

free_small.matching: parameter count of the m=6 learned ICNN (975)

ickan_large.matching: parameter count of the Unconstrained energy (25 473)

recipe_in_memory_change: For each new cell, models.names is set to the cell model and models.widths[family] to the cell widths; every other recipe field, including the class learning rates, is unchanged.
validation_metric: Mean squared normalized validation stress error divided by the frozen fit-stress denominator; strict minimum over initialization, Adam, and L-BFGS.
selection: Within each new cell, the minimum validation score over the three seeds; seed breaks ties.

gates.A: icnn_large and free_small: open after their six runs are terminal and selected.
gates.B: ickan_large: open after its three runs are terminal and selected.

analysis_plan.primary: Independent-test aggregate relative stress error of the validation-selected model in each of the four cells.
secondary: coupon FE2 final-displacement error of each new selected model
analysis_plan.ratios: Report the capacity effect (small/large within each row) and the constraint cost at matched capacity (constrained/unconstrained within each column).
analysis_plan.decision: No model is reselected from test or FE2 results. How the outcome enters the paper is decided with the author after all declared cells are evaluated.
